evidence: Checks the global cache pointer at 0x7003b0cf30. If nonnull it returns; if null it allocates 0x320 bytes, initializes the cache through initialize_ranked_attribute_metrics_cache, and stores the pointer in the global slot. A caller invokes it among a sequence of initialization helpers. The name states only the observed lazy initialization behavior. decompiled/main/main_0104.c:21900-21922; decompiled/main/main_0100.c:13905-13908

Queries attribute-context status selectors 1 and 2, passes each returned value through f_700185c230 (a range-to-class mapper), ORs the mapped outputs, and returns whether either mapped class is nonzero. The caller uses the result as a Boolean gate. The label avoids assigning domain meanings to the classes. decompiled/main/main_0094.c:6729-6749; decompiled/main/main_0170.c:53925-53949; decompiled/main/main_0030.c:53644-53649

Builds a local 64-byte record, initializes its fields with f_700077f56c (null pointers/zero values and a -1 sentinel), then passes that record to process_equipment_attribute_values. Its caller invokes this wrapper in the equipment-attribute path. The local record's field meanings remain unspecified. decompiled/main/main_0057.c:19941-19957; decompiled/main/main_0057.c:3549-3559; decompiled/main/main_0057.c:15465-15480; decompiled/main/main_0058.c:15316-15318

Obtains a selector value from the global context-state helper, stores it as selector 26 when context is available, reads selector 26 if it is below 30, then writes that byte value to selector 27 and writes zero to selector 28 via the context property setter. A caller invokes it while preparing an attribute-context result. The label describes the visible selector operations without assigning field meanings. decompiled/main/main_0058.c:5601-5620; decompiled/main/main_0056.c:36341-36358; decompiled/main/main_0056.c:36096-36106; decompiled/main/main_0169.c:41276-41318; decompiled/main/main_0087.c:19054-19057

Loads a pointer from input+0xc0 and a 32-bit value from input+0xc8, writes 6 to input+0x20, sets remaining helper arguments to zero, and tail-calls update_serialized_record_state. Its caller prepares the record and invokes this wrapper during a serialized-state update path. decompiled/main/main_0091.c:51300-51310; decompiled/main/main_0091.c:48519-48570; decompiled/main/main_0036.c:24980-24989
